# Revibe

> Revibe is a multidisciplinary physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage therapy, osteopathy, naturopathic medicine, performance training and recovery clinic with two locations in the Greater Toronto Area: Revibe Mississauga (2290 Dixie Rd, Mississauga, ON L4Y 1Z4) and Revibe Markham (220 Torbay Rd, Markham, ON L3R 1G6). Rated 5.0 on Google from 700+ reviews. No referral needed; most extended health plans are direct billed.

Key facts:
- Every guest starts with a Care Map: a plan built from seven questions about readiness, activity, capacity, recovery, health, mindset and performance for real life.
- Performance training (strength and conditioning with CSCS certified coaches) is $60 for 30 minutes, $80 for 45 minutes and $100 for 60 minutes, plus HST. Performance rehab with a physiotherapist is $125 for 45 minutes and $150 for 60 minutes, no HST. Blocks of 12, 24 and 48 sessions save 10%, 15% and 20% per session. The first performance consult is free.
- Force plate testing measures braking, force, elasticity and power, with a written baseline report and a retest after each block.
- Team combines test whole teams at either clinic or at the team's own facility, with an individual report per athlete and a team recap afterwards.
- Recovery: cold plunge, infrared sauna and a recovery lounge with Normatec compression.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/timetorevibe/

- [Physio, Massage and Recovery](https://revibeto.com/): Performance therapy clinic in Mississauga and Markham. Physiotherapy, chiro, massage, osteo, naturopathic care, training and recovery. Direct billing.
